sources.title: The Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Challenge — problem description
claims_verified: The target is fault presence with incomplete and potentially inaccurate public known-fault labels; new faults are expert-identified.
Initial private test labels and final expanded labels are distinct scoring rounds; the selected submission is reused.
The metric is distance-weighted Tversky with alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, and a triangular kernel with 300 m support.
Submission: one float32 GeoTIFF layer, EPSG:32611, 100 m resolution, matching bounds; values in [0,1]; outside the bounds null or NaN.
sources.limits: Public/private leaderboard values were not accessed. The official data-download tab redirects to login in this environment.

sources.title: Geologic Enhanced Mapping System (GEMS) Prize Official Rules
claims_verified: A valid entry uses a single GeoTIFF with a single raster layer at 100 m over the GeoDAWN study area.
The rules refer competitors to the competition website for format details and state three submissions per week.
Generative-AI use is allowed but must be disclosed in the narrative, including its extent and how it contributed to submission elements.
sources.limits: The competition interface was not used; submission/upload was not attempted. The user remains responsible for accurate authorship and results statements.

sources.title: INGENIOUS — Great Basin Regional Dataset Compilation, DOI 10.15121/1881483
claims_verified: The public CC-BY 4.0 compilation includes magnetotelluric/electrical-conductance maps and multiple other geoscience themes.
The listed conductance release describes five depth ranges spanning 2 to 200 km.
sources.limits: Individual raster bytes, effective spatial resolution, and exact GEMS-footprint coverage were not retrieved or checked.

sources.title: OPERA Surface Displacement from Sentinel-1 validated product, version 1
claims_verified: The product reports 30 m spatial posting and line-of-sight displacement from Sentinel-1 interferometric time-series analysis.
The collection has broad North American coverage and temporal extent beginning 2016-07-01; the page also describes the Sentinel data as 2016–2025.
sources.limits: A product-wide extent does not prove a usable granule/track for every GEMS cell; no granule selection or access test was run.

sources.title: GEMSDOE28 public research page and H27-4 artifact status
claims_verified: The owner page labels the listed H27-4 artifact UNSCORED and reports catalogue-gap holdout gains, not a competition score.
The page lists H27-4 filename gems28-h27-4-r1-solo-d2-8-20261003-8acb75e1f2cc-nan.tif, SHA-256 ab02300152248fdda04e988e2cd2a0c13f35eec42fcf670a15e8b76b19e24a73, and 40,199 positive cells.
The page describes the D2.8 base as owner-reported 0.2600; this conflicts with the pinned GEMSDOE25 registry that marks its D2.8 file unscored.
sources.limits: Owner-maintained site, not an organizer receipt. Page deployment identity was not proven to equal the repository HEAD; the TIFF was not downloaded or independently audited in this checkout.

sources.title: USGS FDSN Event Web Service / ComCat moment-tensor query
claims_verified: The official API documentation supports custom event queries and count requests.
A broad approximate-envelope query returned 618 event records with a moment-tensor product; an inspected event record lists focal-mechanism and moment-tensor product types.
sources.limits: The query rectangle is an approximate envelope, not the exact competition footprint. Count and one inspected record do not verify spatial distribution, solution quality, independent station coverage, data license for every product component, or holdout utility. No model was fit.

sources.title: ASTER L2 Surface Reflectance VNIR and SWIR V004 (AST_07.004)
claims_verified: NASA CMR describes AST_07.004 as ASTER VNIR/SWIR surface reflectance with 15 m VNIR and 30 m SWIR posting.
The approximate-bbox preflight returned at least one pre-2008 granule whose reported polygon intersects the broad query rectangle; linked SWIR assets use lp-prod-protected URLs.
CMR metadata notes ASTER SWIR detector failure on 2009-01-12 and warns about earlier anomaly periods.
sources.limits: No ASTER binary was downloaded, no Earthdata-authenticated access was available or tested, and one matching granule is not full-footprint coverage. The approximate rectangle is not the exact GEMS polygon.

sources.publisher: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data for the Nation
sources.title: Modernized Water Data OGC API — field measurements
claims_verified: The official collection schema includes groundwater field measurement parameter codes, values, dates, units, vertical datum, and approval status.
A broad approximate-bbox API request returned groundwater-level field-measurement records, including an approved steel-tape reading at a location within the query rectangle.
USGS's 2025 API transition notice states the legacy /nwis/gwlevels/ endpoint is decommissioned; the modern Water Data API is the current route.
sources.limits: The 10-row sample is not a total count, full-footprint coverage analysis, repeated-well audit, or common-datum check. The query uses an approximate rectangle. No features were written to the repository or used in a model.
